outer_split: leave one physical P1 cell out (6 folds)
inner_split: leave one of remaining 5 physical cells out
output_target: P1 target_soh_pp minus public same-cell anchor SOH pp
label_access: runner only; feature builder uses D1Visibility without label columns
extra_scalar_channel: count of prior first-3.50V shallow-prefix-qualified charge events; same for all methods; no complete-event Ah; mandatory no-count ablation
standardization: training rows only; missing numerical features imputed with training median; all-missing feature zero
metric: physical-cell macro MAE SOH percentage points over all 180 targets
claim_limit: D1 same-six-cell deep-charge crop proxy, not independent shallow cycling or official 4S C/20 accuracy
